discover_candidates_decision_timestamps_.name: discover_candidates_decision_timestamps_check
discover_candidates_decision_timestamps_.value:
("discover_candidates"."state" = 'pending' and "discover_candidates"."kept_at" is null and "discover_candidates"."rejected_at" is null)
        or ("discover_candidates"."state" = 'kept' and "discover_candidates"."kept_at" is not null and "discover_candidates"."rejected_at" is null)
        or ("discover_candidates"."state" = 'rejected' and "discover_candidates"."kept_at" is null and "discover_candidates"."rejected_at" is not null)

discover_provider_targets_claim_check.name: discover_provider_targets_claim_check
discover_provider_targets_claim_check.value:
("discover_provider_targets"."claim_token" is null and "discover_provider_targets"."claim_expires_at" is null)
        or ("discover_provider_targets"."claim_token" is not null and "discover_provider_targets"."claim_expires_at" is not null)

learning_plan_item_placements_variant_ch.name: learning_plan_item_placements_variant_check
learning_plan_item_placements_variant_ch.value:
(
        "learning_plan_item_placements"."stage_id" is not null
        and "learning_plan_item_placements"."node_id" is null
        and "learning_plan_item_placements"."node_kind" is null
      ) or (
        "learning_plan_item_placements"."stage_id" is null
        and "learning_plan_item_placements"."node_id" is not null
        and "learning_plan_item_placements"."node_kind" = 'item'
      )
